phases.objective: Prove environment/deployment authority, runtime immutability, bounded break-glass D01-D06 behavior, and Track B D07-D13 reconciliation-readiness evidence remain fail-closed without applying migrations, activating later runtime transitions, writing protected branches, or mutating Production.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Spec 018 environment authority plus Hostinger deploy compatibility surface
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A deployment candidate can proceed past branch authority only when the governed Production branch and exact same-cycle expected commit match; arbitrary branch selection and stale SHA fail closed before dispatch.
steps: Resolve the governed Production branch from environment authority without reading provider credentials.
Read the same-cycle Production ref through the governed read-only GitHub authority path and compare it with expected_commit_sha.
Reject main, arbitrary work branches, invalid SHA, and stale SHA before deployment planning becomes eligible.
assertions: Production branch authority is policy-derived rather than caller-selected.
Routine SSH application-code mutation remains denied.
No migration, protected-branch write, provider mutation, Production mutation, or secret-bearing output is performed by this synthetic journey.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger production target policy plus deployment-info diagnostics
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Routine local application-code mutation remains denied while tracked checkout drift is classified independently from service health through read-only evidence.
steps: Verify Production target metadata keeps routine SSH application-code mutation disabled.
Classify tracked dirty state, commit mismatch, or unavailable checkout evidence as degraded runtime integrity.
Expose runtime_integrity through deployment-info without exposing changed paths, file contents, credentials, or secrets.
assertions: A healthy diagnostic surface may still report degraded runtime integrity.
Runtime integrity evidence is read-only and secret-free.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Break-glass persistence, governed capability-envelope issuer, run-bound verification producer, and fail-closed lifecycle planner
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A break-glass incident is only shadow-eligible when bounded incident, authority, exact-path, hash-readback, rollback, expiry, and verification evidence pass; D07-D13 runtime transitions remain blocked.
steps: Validate additive incident persistence and authority metadata remain fail-closed and unapplied.
Bind approval and verification to incident, principals, exact commit, allowed paths, hashes, rollback intent, and bounded expiry.
Require persisted post-change readback and fresh run-bound runtime verification evidence before D01-D06 lifecycle progress.
Keep MAIN_COMMITTED and later runtime transitions blocked by the follow-up phase requirement.
assertions: Broad shell or filesystem mutation is never an accepted break-glass substitute.
D07-D13 runtime transitions remain blocked by BREAK_GLASS_FOLLOWUP_PHASE_REQUIRED.
The shadow planner performs no Hostinger mutation, provider call, protected-branch write, migration apply, or secret-bearing output.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: D07-D13 reconciliation evidence is classified as ready for Track A consumption only when governed Git representation, exact commit reachability, staging verification, governed Production-promotion evidence, clean redeploy/readback, replay protection, expiry, and rollback rehearsal evidence are complete and fresh.
steps: Validate the expected commit, bounded authorization expiry, governed Git representation, and exact path-hash coverage.
Require fresh main reachability and staging verification for the exact expected commit.
Require evidence that Production promotion used the normal governed flow and that clean redeploy/readback bind to the exact Production SHA with zero unreconciled local differences.
Reject replayed, stale, expired, incomplete, or mismatched evidence and classify rollback rehearsal without executing rollback.
assertions: Track B grants no Final Authority and performs no runtime state transition.
Runtime transition activation remains false even when evidence is ready for Track A consumption.
No protected-branch write, deployment, provider call, database mutation, migration apply, Production mutation, or secret-bearing output occurs.
Replay, stale evidence, expired authorization, incomplete reconciliation, and rollback-readiness mismatch fail closed.

phases.objective: Track A may consume the D07-D13 readiness evidence to implement governed runtime lifecycle transitions only after independent authority and integration gates; Track B does not activate those transitions.
Prove live failure-mode reconciliation, provider/readback faults, rollback, expiry, and no-secret behavior under separately authorized integration work.
Validate the integrated candidate on main staging with exact-SHA readback and no Production mutation before promotion.
Verify exact Production SHA promotion, immutable Hostinger runtime alignment, deployment attestation, rollback readiness, and post-deploy integrity under separate release authorization.
